calls.title: GrowthBook <> Cornell University - Intro
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) introduced GrowthBook’s open-source experimentation platform to Federico Raimondi Slepoi, a researcher at Harvard and Cornell who runs A/B tests for field experiments with partner companies. Key pain points included data sovereignty concerns for European partners and a technical issue with overlapping user assignments (0.8% misassignment). Next steps: Daniel will send product resources and a test account, and Federico will connect GrowthBook with his partner companies when they are ready to run experiments,
